meta.title: Theophylline pharmacokinetics (Theoph)
meta.description: Twelve subjects received an oral dose of theophylline; serum concentrations were measured at 11 time points over the next 25 hours (132 observations in total).
meta.source: Boeckmann, A. J., Sheiner, L. B. and Beal, S. L. (1994), NONMEM Users Guide: Part V, NONMEM Project Group, University of California, San Francisco. The study was run by Dr Robert Upton.
secondary: Davidian, M. and Giltinan, D. M. (1995) Nonlinear Models for Repeated Measurement Data, Chapman and Hall (section 5.5, p. 145 and section 6.6, p. 176)
Pinheiro, J. C. and Bates, D. M. (2000) Mixed-effects Models in S and S-PLUS, Springer (Appendix A.29)
meta.distribution: Data set Theoph of the R datasets package (originally part of nlme), redistributed as CSV by the Rdatasets collection: https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/csv/datasets/Theoph.csv ; documentation https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/doc/datasets/Theoph.html
meta.notes: Subjects are numbered 1 to 12 as in the CSV. The R documentation orders subjects by increasing maximum observed concentration, not by this number.

meta.title: Indomethacin pharmacokinetics (Indometh)
meta.description: Six subjects received an intravenous injection of indomethacin; plasma concentrations were measured at 11 times from 0.25 to 8 hours after the injection (66 observations in total).
meta.source: Kwan, K. C., Breault, G. O., Umbenhauer, E. R., McMahon, F. G. and Duggan, D. E. (1976) Kinetics of indomethacin absorption, elimination, and enterohepatic circulation in man. Journal of Pharmacokinetics and Biopharmaceutics 4, 255-280.
secondary: Davidian, M. and Giltinan, D. M. (1995) Nonlinear Models for Repeated Measurement Data, Chapman and Hall (section 5.2.4, p. 129)
Pinheiro, J. C. and Bates, D. M. (2000) Mixed-effects Models in S and S-PLUS, Springer
meta.distribution: Data set Indometh of the R datasets package (originally part of nlme), redistributed as CSV by the Rdatasets collection: https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/csv/datasets/Indometh.csv ; documentation https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/doc/datasets/Indometh.html
meta.notes: The dose is not stated in the R documentation and the original article could not be accessed to verify it, so no dose is recorded. Use the profiles for shape, half-lives and dose-normalised comparisons, not for absolute clearance or volume.
